description: Inner-CV regularisation: RidgeCV alpha per target (GCV) and LogisticRegressionCV C by Brier, training fold only

model.formula: size_j = ridge(material one-hot + log1p(aging)/7 + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35)); logit P_j = same design, L2 logistic (C=1)
model.notes: Per-target ridge alpha (GCV) and logistic C (inner 5-fold Brier) chosen on the training fold only.
